Ruddy snake-bull. Upper torso of bull, including two hooves. Lower snake half. Entrails grant heroic visions.

AC 12, HP 41, ATK 2 gore +6 (2d8) and 1 constrict (near), MV near (swim), S +6, D +3, C +5, I -2, W +5, Ch +1, AL N, LV 8

Apocalyptic Vision. If damaged, creature inflicting damage, WIS 15+ or mind filled with visions of death for 1d4 rounds.

Constrict. Contested STR to hold target immobile for one round.

Questing Beast. Mortals eating entrails of a freshly slain ophiotaurus, CON 15+ or reduced to 0 HP. On success, have vision of mythic quest (as per scrying spell).
